package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
)

func require(ok bool, invariant string) {
	if !ok {
		panic(invariant)
	}
}

func main() {
	two := "Process 402715 waits for ShareLock on transaction 701234; blocked by process 402716.\nProcess 402716 waits for ShareLock on transaction 701235; blocked by process 402715."
	want := onboardingDeadlockMetadata(two)
	require(want.State == "cycle_observed_owners_unmapped" && len(want.Edges) == 2, "two participants retained without owner inference")
	require(want.Edges[0].Waiter == "p1" && want.Edges[0].Blocker == "p2" && want.Edges[0].Object == "x1", "per-observation labels")
	lines := strings.Split(two, "\n")
	require(reflect.DeepEqual(want, onboardingDeadlockMetadata(lines[1]+"\n"+lines[0])), "input line order does not alter normalized graph")
	three := "Process 402715 waits for ShareLock on transaction 701234; blocked by process 402716.\nProcess 402716 waits for ExclusiveLock on transaction 701235; blocked by process 402717.\nProcess 402717 waits for ShareLock on transaction 701236; blocked by process 402715."
	require(len(onboardingDeadlockMetadata(three).Edges) == 3, "three participant cycle retained")
	reject := []string{
		"", lines[0], two+"\n", two+"\nPRIVATE_CYCLE_PROSE",
		strings.Replace(two, "ShareLock", "PRIVATE_CYCLE_PROSE", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "transaction 701234", "relation 701234 of database 701239", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "402715 waits", "0 waits", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "402715 waits", "9999999999 waits", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "701234", "18446744073709551616", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "402715 waits", "-402715 waits", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "blocked by process 402716", "blocked by process 402715", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "blocked by process 402715.", "blocked by process 402718.", 1),
		strings.Replace(two, "Process 402716 waits", "Process 402715 waits", 1),
		two+"\n"+strings.ReplaceAll(strings.ReplaceAll(two, "402715", "502715"), "402716", "502716"),
		strings.Repeat("PRIVATE_CYCLE_PROSE", 4096),
	}
	for i, input := range reject {
		got := onboardingDeadlockMetadata(input)
		require(got.State == "cycle_unparsed" && len(got.Edges) == 0, fmt.Sprintf("unrecognized input %d must be atomic unparsed", i))
	}
	var eight []string
	for i := 1; i <= 8; i++ {
		eight = append(eight, fmt.Sprintf("Process %d waits for ShareLock on transaction %d; blocked by process %d.", i, i+100, i%8+1))
	}
	require(len(onboardingDeadlockMetadata(strings.Join(eight, "\n")).Edges) == 8, "bounded eight participant cycle retained")
	require(onboardingDeadlockMetadata(strings.Join(eight, "\n")+"\n"+eight[0]).State == "cycle_unparsed", "ninth record refused")
	raw, err := json.Marshal(want)
	require(err == nil, "JSON encoding")
	for _, forbidden := range []string{"402715", "402716", "701234", "701235", "PRIVATE_CYCLE_PROSE", "Detail", "Where", "InternalQuery"} {
		require(!strings.Contains(string(raw), forbidden), "native values/prose not exported")
	}
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("one generated output directory required")
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(os.Args[1]+"/cycle.json", raw, 0600); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Println("PASS actual parser: cycles, aliases, bounded/atomic refusal, secret-bearing detail and native-number redaction; no owner inference")
}
